name: Regime + low-realized-vol double gate arms momentum (macro gate orthogonal to the vol gate)
rationale: THESIS: A calm-volatility regime (vol_realized inside a fitted low band) is known to make momentum cleaner — this is the existing vol-regime-gated-momentum seed family. The new claim is that macro_regime adds a SECOND, ORTHOGONAL gate: calm vol says 'price is orderly' but macro_regime says 'the macro tape rewards risk' — you can have orderly price IN a risk-off drift (a slow bleed is low-vol too) which is exactly where calm-vol momentum gets chopped. Stacking the macro gate on top should remove those orderly-but-wrong-tape losers. Entry: macro_regime>floor AND vol_realized<vol_ceiling AND ret_Nd>mom_floor. DISCONFIRMER: run the SAME entry with macro_regime DROPPED but the vol_realized calm band kept (the documented vol-gated-momentum family). If vol-gated-alone reproduces the macro+vol net-of-fee Sharpe, the macro gate is redundant to the calm-vol filter and carries no orthogonal macro information — falsified. The macro gate must add incremental net edge over the vol-only seed.
catalyst: Risk-on macro regime co-occurs with a calm realized-vol regime and positive trend — the macro window arms momentum only when price is orderly AND the tape rewards risk.
